welcome_sub: A short check in your language. No machine needed.
consent_body: This is a screening, not a medical check. Your photo is not stored. Only numbers are kept.
consent_store: You may store the name and phone number of the customer
cal_step1: Hold a bank card flat on the glass. Move the slider until the box is as wide as the card.
cal_step2: Check: the box should now be as tall as the card.
cal_bad: This size looks wrong. Please try again.
cal_reuse: This phone was set up before. Use the saved size?
test_cover_right: Cover the LEFT eye with your palm. The RIGHT eye is tested.
test_cover_left: Cover the RIGHT eye with your palm. The LEFT eye is tested.
test_direction_q: Which way do the arms of the E point?
near_hint: Hold the phone at reading distance.
astig_q: Do some lines look darker or sharper than the others?
astig_note: Possible astigmatism. An eye doctor must measure it.
color_invalid: The colour check was not valid.
dist_cam_fail: Camera not working. Measure with a tape instead.
dist_acc: Distance is an estimate, about plus or minus 15 percent.
photo_face_hint: Customer looks straight at the camera, face well lit, at arm's length.
photo_glasses_hint: Place the glasses flat on a plain light surface next to a card. Photograph straight down.
photo_ok: Photo checked. The photo was deleted.
photo_needs_internet: Photo check needs internet. You can skip it.
photo_manual_hint: Tap the left and right edge of the frame, then the two ends of the card.
int_voice_internet: Voice needs internet. Please tap your answer.
int_voice_odia_off: Voice is off for Odia. Please tap your answer.
int_no_match: We could not match that. Please tap your answer.
q_screen: How many hours a day on a phone or screen?
q_headache: Headaches after reading or screen work?
q_night: Trouble driving or seeing at night?
q_exam: When was your last eye exam?
q_r_sudden: Sudden change in vision in the last 3 months?
q_r_flash: Flashes of light or new floaters?
q_r_diabetes: Diabetes (sugar), now or in the past?
q_r_injury: Past eye injury or eye surgery?
res_block: No lens suggestion is shown until a doctor has checked your eyes.
res_power_note: This is a rough range, not a prescription.
res_source_model: Based on rules and a small model
res_offline: Offline: this page uses rules only. The model range needs internet.
lens_NONE_UNTIL_DOCTOR: No lens suggestion until an eye doctor has checked
code_AGE_TOO_YOUNG: Young children need a full eye exam
code_EYE_VERY_LOW: One eye saw very little on the chart
code_BETTER_EYE_LOW: Even the better eye saw little on the chart
code_EYE_DIFFERENCE_LARGE: The two eyes differ a lot
code_EXAM_OVERDUE: Last eye exam was long ago
blue_light_note: Optional comfort filter. Evidence that it protects eye health is limited.
color_note: Some answers differed. This is only a hint. Screens vary.
disclaimer_default: VisionLite is a screening and recommendation tool. It does not diagnose, and it does not replace an eye doctor.
